abstract: Audits subsea habitat engineering, jointing chamber availability, and mobilization timelines
system_message:
You are the Subsea jointing technical authority (SJT), responsible for auditing subsea habitat engineering, jointing chamber availability, mobilization timelines, and breathing atmosphere management.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits subsea habitat engineering, jointing chamber availability, and mobilization timelines（HABITAT）
information_points.content:
SJT-HABITAT-VD2：Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium maintains certified high-voltage jointing enclosure availability with active type certification for 132 kV to 220 kV subsea joint assembly in its candidate subsea dry hyperbaric habitat. Its guaranteed jointing habitat mobilization time from the candidate shore base to complete deck fastening on the repair vessel is 24 h.
SJT-HABITAT-21F：North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership confirms certified high-voltage jointing enclosure availability for 132 kV to 220 kV subsea joint assembly within its dry hyperbaric habitat. Its jointing habitat mobilization time from call-out notice to complete deck fastening on the repair vessel is 36 h.
SJT-HABITAT-5PO：Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance holds certified high-voltage jointing enclosure availability for 132 kV to 220 kV subsea joint assembly across its dry hyperbaric habitat. The jointing habitat mobilization time required from its shore base to quayside load-out and vessel deck fastening is 60 h.

information_points.title: Breathing atmosphere management（GAS）
information_points.content:
SJT-GAS-GZS：North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership records a Nitrox chamber reserve duration of 48 h of autonomous mixed-gas life support endurance without surface resupply.
SJT-GAS-TTP：Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance provides a Nitrox chamber reserve duration of 96 h for autonomous mixed-gas life support endurance in its subsea hyperbaric systems without surface resupply.
SJT-GAS-Q0Y：Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium maintains a Nitrox chamber reserve duration of 72 h of autonomous mixed-gas life support endurance across its subsea hyperbaric systems without surface resupply.
